answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for 30 epochs and is forfeited if that identity is later caught attesting junk. An attacker spinning up 500 fake agents must fund all of them through the whole lock, like stacking timber that may never become a house, while one slash burns the entire pile. Patient honest agents treat the lock as a safe haven; a sybil ring sees its saffron-priced compute evaporate before it can cash out.
